newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Direct Capital to buy back more shares.
newsitem.headline: Direct Capital to buy back more shares.

text.p: New Zealand investment company Direct Capital Partners Ltd said on Friday it was increasing the number of shares it intends to buy back.
It now plans to buy up to 4.25 million, up from 2.5 million.

DCP first announced last June that it was entering the market to buy ordinary shares at up to NZ$0.75. Late last month it said it had acquired 2.185 million at an average price of NZ$0.71, representing about three percent of shares on issue.
It said then that a share price below $0.75 represented an inappropriately high discount to asset backing.
